stepTitle: Milad has performed one-hot encoding on one column.
stepBody:
Milad creates a DataFrame called features and a Series called target using the code snippet below. Assume that there is no value in genre called "genre".

from $$	exttt{sklearn.linear\_model}$$ import LinearRegression
target $$=$$ $$	exttt{song\_sample["streams"]}$$
features $$=$$ $$	exttt{song\_sample[["genre"]]}$$

for $$	exttt{curr\_g}$$ in features["genre"].unique():
$$	exttt{features[curr\_g]}$$ $$=$$ (features["genre"] $$==$$ $$	exttt{curr\_g).astype(int)}$$

features $$=$$ features.drop("genre", $$axis=1)$$

model $$=$$ $$	exttt{LinearRegression(fit\_intercept=False)}$$
model.fit(features, target)
